description: This file contains utility functions and encoders for converting Python objects to JSON-compatible formats, specifically tailored for FastAPI and Pydantic models. It includes custom encoders, handling for various data types, and integration with FastAPI's exception handling.

methods.name: isoformat
methods.description: Converts a date or time object to its ISO 8601 string representation.

methods.name: decimal_encoder
methods.description: Encodes a Decimal as an int if no exponent, otherwise as a float.

methods.name: generate_encoders_by_class_tuples
methods.description: Creates a mapping from encoder functions to the types they handle.

methods.name: jsonable_encoder
methods.description: Recursively converts Python objects into JSON-serializable formats, handling various data types and models.
